# Package Manager Recommendations for Windows Development

Based on your needs for handling application dependencies on Windows, here are my top recommendations:

---

## **For General Development: [Chocolatey](https://chocolatey.org/)**

```powershell
# Install Chocolatey
Set-ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Scope Process -Force; [System.Net.ServiceClient]::SecurityProtocol = [System.Net.ServiceClient]::SecurityProtocol -bor 3072; iex ((New-Object System.Net.WebClient).DownloadString('https://community.chocolatey.org/install.ps1'))

# Example usage
choco install nodejs python git -y
```

**Pros:**
- Largest Windows package repository
- Mature and well-documented
- Great for system-wide tools

---

## **For Modern Windows (10/11): [winget](https://github.com/microsoft/winget-cli)**

```powershell
# Usually pre-installed on Windows 11
winget install Microsoft.VisualStudioCode
winget install Python.Python.3.11
```

**Pros:**
- Built-in to Windows (no extra install)
- Microsoft-supported
- Growing repository

---

## **Language-Specific Managers**

| Language | Package Manager | Command Example |
|----------|-----------------|-----------------|
| JavaScript | npm / yarn / pnpm | `npm install express` |
| Python | pip / poetry | `pip install requests` |
| .NET | NuGet | `dotnet add package Newtonsoft.Json` |
| Rust | Cargo | `cargo add serde` |

---

## **My Recommendation**

> Use **winget** for installing development tools + your **language-specific manager** for project dependencies.

What languages/frameworks are you primarily working with? I can give more specific guidance.
